name: Mini Sunset Lamp — Cat Ear
description: A small USB-powered lamp that casts a sunset-style circle of light on your wall. The round head sits on a short base and tilts to aim the glow, and has little ears on top. Available in black and pink. Check which versions come with a remote before you order.
notes: Listing is a 10-style range, ¥3.3 to ¥15.5 (₦736 to ₦3,459 on the page); per-style price not shown, so unit_cost is blank. USB powered, no battery, ships by air. Return rate cut off in screenshot. Seller text claims remote switches 16 colours: not repeated. Supplier banner with certification claims cropped out and not repeated. Remote only seen on the pink photo; description kept neutral. Ear colours vary between photos (teal, orange); not stated. Photos are 800 px, soft when enlarged. Black photo has no remote; owner to confirm what each colour includes.
